learnings: Tool errors on non-executable files (.gitignore, .SRCINFO) should not escalate to full re-audits; the system should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to security uncertainty' and 'inconclusive due to infrastructure failure'
Files like .gitignore that contain no executable code should be fast-pathed or excluded from LLM review to avoid wasting tokens and triggering unnecessary escalations
When a model fails on a file due to API errors, the audit system should retry or fall back to a simpler model rather than marking the entire package inconclusive
